Christmas Spectacular Starring The Radio City Rockettes

10:00 AM · Radio City Music Hall, Midtown-Times Square · ↻ Every Saturday

Children younger than 24 months may attend without the purchase of a ticket, however, they may not occupy their own separate seat and must sit on a parent or guardian's lap. Please note that government mandates, venue protocols and event requirements are subject to change. Be sure to visit rockettes.com/faq for the latest information. There is a fourteen (14) ticket limit per purchaser over the entire 2026 Christmas Spectacular season. The Christmas Spectacular is an immersive experience that includes confetti, pyrotechnics, smoke effects, intense lighting, visual effects, loud noises, flashing lights and flying objects (drones). Such elements may aggravate certain medical or physical conditions, and guests should take into consideration if they have a history of discomfort or physical symptoms when experiencing these elements.

The Conversation

2:00 PM · Astor Place Theatre, Greenwich Village · ↻ Every Saturday Para salir

THE CONVERSATION follows Marcus (Tony Award-winner Joshua Henry) and Elle (Julia Harriman) from the electric spark of their first date to move-ins, milestones, and the slow accumulation of everything left unsaid. The score, written by Henry and Harriman, weaves soul, R&B, and modern pop into bold musical theater storytelling that is intimate, honest, and emotionally gripping. With a book by Nick Green and directed by Tony Award-winner Kenny Leon, The Conversation asks what it takes to choose love, even when it hurts, and what it takes to stay.

A Ghost in Your Ear

5:00 PM · Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre, Greenwich Village · ↻ Every Saturday Para salir

When an actor arrives late to a sound studio for a last-minute audiobook recording session, he is handed the script of a chilling ghost story to read. But as the engineer cues the recording and the evening wears on, the horrors slowly begin to escape the page to haunt the studio itself. Fresh from an acclaimed, sold-out run in London, A GHOST IN YOUR EAR is the "truly terrifying headphone horror" (The Guardian) from the darkly brilliant mind of Tony Award® nominee Jamie Armitage (SIX), made in collaboration with Ben and Max Ringham (ANNA, National Theatre). A mesmerizing blend of gothic horror and psychological thriller, this cutting-edge theatrical experience uses groundbreaking binaural sound technology to immerse every audience member in a haunting world of sound. And at Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre - one of New York's most intimate venues - there's no escaping the frights. Enter if you dare.

Glorelys

6:45 PM · Brooklyn Improv (The Lab), Williamsburg · $30.53

Glorelys Mora is a Dominican-American stand-up comedian, actress, and writer born and raised in New York City. She is also the co-founder and host of Morir Soñandoytelling, she brings a distinctly New York perspective to relationships, family, pop culture, and everyday life. Glorelys has appeared on Netflix Is a Joke and Funny AF with Kevin Hart and was a finalist in the HBO Latino Stand-Up Competition. She has performed at The Comedy Store, Hollywood Improv, Laugh Factory, The Stand, and New York Comedy Club, and has opened for Leslie Jones, Zainab Johnson, and Erik Rivera. Her sold-out debut at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe earned a five-star review and critical acclaim. Her film credits include B Is for Bachata and We're Not Married Yet, now streaming on Tubi. She is also the co-founder and host of Morir Soñando Comedy, a live comedy show and podcast celebrating Dominican and New York culture. Geoffrey Keezer Trio with Yasushi Nakamura and Billy Kilson

7:00 PM · Birdland Theater, Hell's Kitchen · $35.46

GRAMMY®-winning pianist and composer GEOFFREY KEEZER brings an all-star trio to the Birdland Theater featuring Yasushi Nakamura on bass and Billy Kilson on drums. Geoffrey Keezer has been a major figure in NYC's jazz piano scene since 1989, when he became the last pianist with the legendary Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers. Keezer has toured and recorded with Ray Brown, Roy Hargrove, Joshua Redman, Diana Krall, Art Farmer, Benny Golson, Barbara Hendricks, Wayne Shorter, Dianne Reeves, David Sanborn, Chris Botti, Sting, Joe Locke and Christian McBride. Time Magazine wrote, , "rdquo" -> Geoffrey has more than enough virtuosity and sheer musical wit and intelligence to weave all of his apparently disparate strands of influence into an original and compelling whole", and pop icon Sting said , "rdquo" -> In the universe of piano players that I have been exposed to over the years, Geoffrey has proved himself to be not only a superb technician and improviser, but also above and beyond this, a composer and conceptualist who can maintain the overall line and the DNA of the song in everything he plays. A musician's musician."
